justification: Inspected javaparser-core-serialization/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/serialization/JavaParserJsonSerializer.java and javaparser-core-serialization/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/serialization/JavaParserJsonDeserializer.java. JsonTokenRange is a tiny nested enum with only 2 constants (BEGIN_TOKEN, END_TOKEN), one constructor, and one toString method; it serves only as a property-key holder for token-range JSON fields used by writeTokens/readTokenRange. There is no evidence of many methods, multiple responsibilities, or low cohesion, so insufficient modularization is not present.
